doc: GENERATED warning ratchet (validator section 17) -- do not hand-edit. `make validate` fails when the live per-rule warning histogram differs from this one, in EITHER direction. To change it, run `make warning-baseline` and commit the result in the SAME commit as the spec/code change that moved the number; a deliberate INCREASE is recorded by that diff plus one line in the PR body saying why the warning is accepted.
